label: Beurre Rose
note: Luxembourg cultured milk butter, PDO since 2000; the name comes from the pink state quality label, not the butter; continuous churning, tested 15 times a year

about.text: Cultured milk butter from Luxembourg under the national quality mark, PDO since 2000. The name comes from the pink quality label, not from the butter. Made by continuous churning and tested 15 times a year.
